what: Proposed rc2/rc3 warning logging does not require suppressing append-tool-failure output
scenario_or_breakage: In a retained plan-review-loop check-plan-size rc2/rc3 path, append-tool-failure.sh can emit APPENDED= and LOG= lines into plan-review-loop stdout, polluting the machine-readable loop stream
suggested_fix: Add the same >/dev/null 2>&1 || true suppression required for design-postplan-emit.sh, and test no APPENDED= or LOG= leakage
